description: Order a LAFU setup for a screen (or ask for a quote when the plan has no price, or for custom work). area + planId from oma_lafu_services, brief = what you need, context = what was already filled in on that screen (short text values; never passwords or keys), serviceId = your site or service it is for. Businesses (company + business ID) get an invoice and work starts at once; consumers pay the invoice online first. A support ticket opens for the LAFU team with all of this. Needs confirm. Returns a proposal + confirmToken; call oma_confirm_tool next.

context.description: What was already filled in on that screen (short values, never passwords or keys).

serviceId.description: Your site or service the setup is for.

name: oma_lafu_service_order
title: Order a LAFU setup
